g.text: 4 independent source chains × 512 parent trajectories per bead count; dt = 0.02; 256 bootstrap draws; potential split: lowest adiabatic.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516171

g.text: Shading: pointwise 95% percentile intervals from source-chain / circular-block joint-ratio bootstrap; signs and their shared normalization are retained.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516171

g.text: Intervals are conditional on source mixing and selected block lengths. A failed gate withholds the band; it is never replaced by a zero-width interval.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516171

g.text: Dashed curves and black markers use the original published vertices / marker centers. Their vertical bars are conservative graphic-readout bounds,

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516171

g.text: which are separate from Monte Carlo uncertainty. Gray curves are an independently recomputed spectral Kubo reference.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516171

g.text: This is a benchmark of the paper's nonadiabatic model. It does not establish physical convergence or validate the electrochemical reservoir or adaptive path.
